title: Desktop App Version 26.727 - Enhanced Browser & Activity View
description: Enhanced browser with address bar history search, multi-repository code review across folders, expanded image editing with Canvas/Focused views, and new Activity view sidebar.

title: Cursor on iPad
description: Cursor launched its iPad app, bringing the AI-powered code editor to Apple's tablet platform.

title: Codex CLI 0.146.0 - Session Management & Multi-provider Support
description: Added session naming with /new and /clear commands, thread pinning, Amazon Bedrock and Claude Code marketplace support, WebSocket support for remote code-mode hosts, and paginated thread history with temporary forks.

title: Gemini CLI v0.53.0 - Security & Workflow Automation
description: Implemented LLM triage orchestration and container build setup, added evaluation coverage reporting, enhanced security with workspace trust enforcement and infinite loop mitigations.

title: Cursor Start
description: New feature called Cursor Start was announced, improving onboarding and setup experience for new users.

title: Desktop App Version 26.715 - ChatGPT Voice & Multi-folder Projects
description: ChatGPT Voice powered by GPT-Live, multi-folder local projects support, and screen context sharing on macOS.

title: Gemini CLI v0.52.0 - Core Triage Worker & File Handling
description: Built core triage worker modules and execution loops, improved file handling for JSON and IPYNB files, updated authentication libraries and added clearer error messaging.

title: Cursor Router
description: Cursor Router feature was released, enhancing routing capabilities within the IDE.

title: Codex CLI 0.145.0 - Multi-agent V2 & Enhanced Features
description: Stabilized multi-agent V2 with configurable sub-agents, added experimental paginated thread history, import for Cursor and Claude Code settings, Amazon Bedrock login with GPT-5.6 Sol, audio inputs, and streaming realtime V3 conversations.

title: Agent Swarms and Model Economics
description: Published research on agent swarms and new model economics, exploring the future of AI-powered development workflows.
